Sofia: FYI - HorizonAnalytics down ~22% weekly usage, renewal in 34 days. NPS flagged onboarding friction + two failed webhook retries. Thinking a short 'Rapid Rescue' + downgrade-safe credit.
Ethan: agree we need quick action. Hypothesis = onboarding friction + webhook retry storm. Recommend immediate triage + enablement.
Priya: proposed customer offer draft: 30-day Rapid Rescue (15% credit, sandbox seat, 1-hr SE triage). No contract change; we reassess after period. Want to keep language friendly.
Sofia: draft to send: ```Hi <Customer>,
We noticed a 22% drop in weekly usage and recurring webhook retries overnight. We'd like to offer a 30-day Rapid Rescue: 15% account credit, a preconfigured sandbox seat, and a 1-hour technical troubleshooting session with our SE. Action items: [ ] Confirm a 30-min slot [ ] Share failing webhook timestamps + sample request IDs [ ] Accept Rescue. No contract changes; we'll reassess at the end of 30 days.
Best, Sofia (CSM)```
Ethan: add the specific metric to the note (22%) and ask for environment (prod/staging). Also include a short curl snippet for them to run.
Priya: curl snippet to include: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"sample":true}'
```
